title: The apo-structure of the low molecular weight protein-tyrosine phosphatase A (MptpA) from Mycobacterium tuberculosis allows for better target-specific drug development.
experiment: 15N T1, T2 and (1H)-15N heteronuclear NOE relaxation at 600 MHz (TENSOR2 and ModelFree Lipari-Szabo analysis)
buffer: 150 mM NaCl, 50 mM HEPES, 10 mM DTT
construct_or_mutation: full-length M. tuberculosis MptpA (Rv2234, Met1-Ser163 plus N-terminal subcloning residues G(-3)-G(0); 167 residues, 15N-labeled)
other_conditions: 1.0 mM 15N-labeled MptpA; D2O lock, 150 uM DSS; tumbling: tau_c = 12.12 (diffusion anisotropy = 1.25, rhombicity = 0.39 from 108 HN T1/T2 values, p. 34572 and Table 1); rigid core S2 = 0.7-0.9; termini M1, S2, G161, S163 S2 <= 0.3; P-loop N14 S2 = 0.861 ± 0.005; D-loop G118 S2 = 0.662 ± 0.046, V124 S2 = 0.656 ± 0.004, D126 S2 ~ 0.8, and high flexibility by (1H)-15N hetNOE for R116-D123; 仅图示: structure-mapped S2 shown in Fig. 2C, while per-residue relaxation table and plots in supplemental Table S1 and Fig. S3 are not available
alt_state_structure: 2LUO: open D-loop conformation of ligand-free apo-MptpA in solution (Results, p. 34572-34575; Fig. 3B); 1U2P: closed D-loop conformation of chloride-bound MptpA X-ray structure (Results, p. 34572-34575; Fig. 3A); 1U2Q: closed D-loop conformation of glycerol-bound MptpA X-ray structure (Results, p. 34572-34573; Table 2)
related_structures: 1PNT, 1BVH (bovine BPTP); 5PNT (human HCPTP-A); 1D1P (yeast LTP1); 1P8A (T. foetus TPTP); 1ZGG (B. subtilis YxiE); 2GI4 (C. jejuni Cj1258)
author_claim: Backbone 15N spin relaxation shows a rigid Rossmann-fold core (S2 = 0.7-0.9) including P-loop Asn14 (S2 = 0.861 ± 0.005) and catalytic Asp126 (S2 ~ 0.8), alongside increased ps-ns flexibility in D-loop residues Arg116-Asp123/Val124 (Gly118 S2 = 0.662 ± 0.046, Val124 S2 = 0.656 ± 0.004) involved in ligand-gated loop reorientation.
anchor: the P-loop, has a high order parameter of S2 ⫽ 0.861 ⫾ 0.005,
locator: Results, Dynamic Properties of MptpA, p. 34576 and Fig. 2C, p. 34574 (仅图示; supplemental Table S1 and Fig. S3 unavailable); conditions: Experimental Procedures, NMR Spectroscopy, p. 34571-34572
caveat_note: Internal temperature discrepancy: Experimental Procedures (p. 34571) states 15N relaxation was measured at T = 298 K (1.0 mM 15N-MptpA, 150 mM NaCl, 50 mM HEPES pH 7.0, 10 mM DTT, 600 MHz), matching the BMRB 26513 deposit card exactly (298 K, pH 7.0, 600 MHz, 1.0 mM [U-15N] MptpA, 150 mM NaCl, 50 mM HEPES, 10 mM DTT, 167 aa = G(-3)-G(0) + M1-S163), whereas Fig. 2C caption (p. 34574) states backbone dynamics were measured at 600 MHz and T = 303 K. Note also minor residue-label inconsistencies in text: D-loop end is Asp131 (p. 34572, Fig. 2B) vs Gly131 (p. 34576). Supplemental Table S1 and Fig. S3 were not available from EuropePMC, so any internal correlation times or Rex terms in the supplement could not be read.

title: The apo-structure of the low molecular weight protein-tyrosine phosphatase A (MptpA) from Mycobacterium tuberculosis allows for better target-specific drug development.
experiment: Backbone amide exchange broadening in 1H,15N heteronuclear relaxation (600 MHz) and 2D 1H,15N TROSY (900 MHz) spectra of apo-MptpA
temperature: 298 K (600 MHz Methods); 303 K (Fig. 2C and 900 MHz TROSY)
buffer: 150 mM NaCl, 50 mM HEPES, 10 mM DTT (relaxation sample); 50 mM arginine/glutamate, 25 mM HEPES, 10 mM DTT, 10% D2O, 150 uM DSS (303 K TROSY assignment sample)
construct_or_mutation: full-length M. tuberculosis MptpA (Rv2234, Met1-Ser163 plus N-terminal subcloning residues G(-3)-G(0); 167 residues, 15N- or 13C,15N-labeled)
other_conditions: In 600 MHz relaxation analysis (1.0 mM 15N-MptpA), P-loop C11-G13, I15-S18 and D-loop T119-A121, E125, P127 are unobservable due to exchange broadening; in 900 MHz 2D 1H,15N TROSY at 303 K (1.2 mM 13C,15N-MptpA in 50 mM Arg/Glu buffer), 151 of 156 expected backbone amides are resolved while T12, G13, R17, T119, and H132 are missing and weak extra TROSY peaks are noted as possible sample heterogeneity (Fig. 1B)
alt_state_structure: 2LUO: open D-loop conformation of ligand-free apo-MptpA in solution (Results, p. 34572-34575; Fig. 3B); 1U2P: closed D-loop conformation of chloride-bound MptpA X-ray structure (Results, p. 34572-34575; Fig. 3A); 1U2Q: closed D-loop conformation of glycerol-bound MptpA X-ray structure (Results, p. 34572-34573; Table 2)
related_structures: 1PNT, 1BVH (bovine BPTP); 5PNT (human HCPTP-A); 1D1P (yeast LTP1); 1P8A (T. foetus TPTP); 1ZGG (B. subtilis YxiE); 2GI4 (C. jejuni Cj1258)
author_claim: In ligand-free MptpA, multiple backbone resonances in the catalytic P-loop (Cys11-Gly13, Ile15-Ser18) and D-loop (Thr119-Ala121, Glu125, Pro127; plus His132 in 303 K TROSY) are missing due to chemical exchange broadening, reflecting intrinsic conformational plasticity of the active-site loops.
anchor: Thr119–Ala121 as well as Glu125 and Pro127 located in the
locator: Results, Dynamic Properties of MptpA, p. 34576 and NMR Resonance and NOE Cross-peak Assignment of MptpA, p. 34572; Fig. 1B caption, p. 34573; Experimental Procedures, p. 34571
caveat_note: Combines exchange-broadened apo observations reported for the 1.0 mM NaCl/HEPES relaxation sample (matching BMRB 26513 except for the 298 K vs 303 K text/caption discrepancy) and the 1.2 mM Arg/Glu/HEPES structure-assignment sample at 303 K (deposited as updated assignment BMRB 18533). Note that Pro127 is a proline lacking an HN proton even though the text lists 'Glu125 and Pro127' among unobservable D-loop residues.

title: The apo-structure of the low molecular weight protein-tyrosine phosphatase A (MptpA) from Mycobacterium tuberculosis allows for better target-specific drug development.
experiment: Comparison of solution NMR structure ensemble of apo-MptpA (2LUO; NOE, 1D(H,N) RDC in 5 g/L pf1 phage at 600 MHz, 3J(HN,Ha), TALOS+ restraints) with ligand-bound MptpA X-ray structures (1U2P, 1U2Q)
buffer: 50 mM arginine/glutamate, 25 mM HEPES, 10 mM DTT, 10% D2O, 150 uM DSS (5 g/liter pf1 bacteriophage added for RDCs)
construct_or_mutation: full-length M. tuberculosis MptpA (Rv2234, Met1-Ser163 plus G(-3)-G(0); 13C,15N-labeled for 2LUO)
other_conditions: 1.2 mM 13C,15N-MptpA for 2LUO (20-structure bundle: 4,821 NOEs, 119 1D(H,N) RDCs with anisotropy -18.72 and rhombicity 0.17, 83 3J(HN,Ha), 301 torsion angles, 108 T1/T2 diffusion restraints); D-loop RMSD vs 2LUO is 2.14 ± 0.21 Å (1U2P) and 1.92 ± 0.19 Å (1U2Q) vs P-loop 0.31 ± 0.06 and 0.27 ± 0.03 Å; W48 Ne1 - Y128 Oh distance is 19.8 ± 3.5 Å in apo 2LUO vs 7.2 Å in 1U2P (nearly 13 Å displacement); R17 Ca - Y128/Y129 Ca distances are 14.0 ± 1.3 and 15.9 ± 0.8 Å in 2LUO vs 8.9 and 12.5 Å in 1U2P; D126 Ca - R17 Ca is ~3 Å larger in 2LUO; N14 is left-handed alphaL in 18/20 models and alpha-helical in 2/20 models
alt_state_structure: 2LUO: open D-loop conformation of ligand-free apo-MptpA in solution (Results, p. 34572-34575; Fig. 3B); 1U2P: closed D-loop conformation of chloride-bound MptpA X-ray structure (Results, p. 34572-34575; Fig. 3A); 1U2Q: closed D-loop conformation of glycerol-bound MptpA X-ray structure (Results, p. 34572-34573; Table 2)
related_structures: 1PNT, 1BVH (bovine BPTP); 5PNT (human HCPTP-A); 1D1P (yeast LTP1); 1P8A (T. foetus TPTP); 1ZGG (B. subtilis YxiE); 2GI4 (C. jejuni Cj1258)
author_claim: In the ligand-free solution structure (2LUO), the MptpA D-loop (Glu125-Gly130, carrying Tyr128/Tyr129 and catalytic Asp126) and W-loop Trp48 adopt an open conformation displaced by nearly 13 Å relative to the closed chloride/glycerol-bound X-ray structures (1U2P, 1U2Q), demonstrating open-to-closed D-loop rearrangement upon active-site ligand binding.
anchor: open conformation of binding pocket observed in apo-MptpA (PDB entry 2LUO) due to a distance of 19.8 ⫾ 3.5 Å
locator: Results, Comparison of Apo- and Ligand-bound MptpA, p. 34572-34575, Table 1-2, and Fig. 3-4; Discussion, p. 34580; Experimental Procedures, p. 34571-34572
caveat_note: Structure determination of 2LUO used 1.2 mM 13C,15N-MptpA at 303 K in 50 mM Arg/Glu, 25 mM HEPES pH 7.0, 10 mM DTT (plus 5 g/L pf1 phage for RDCs; chemical shifts deposited in BMRB 18533), differing in temperature, buffer, and concentration from the BMRB 26513 relaxation sample (298 K, 1.0 mM in 150 mM NaCl, 50 mM HEPES, 10 mM DTT). Authors note crystal packing restricts Glu125 and Asp126 in X-ray structures 1U2P and 1U2Q (p. 34573), and note the 2/20 alpha-helical vs 18/20 alphaL conformation of Asn14 in 2LUO may be influenced by missing Thr12 and Gly13 amides (p. 34575). Internal residue-label discrepancies: W-loop is Gly44-Asp55 (p. 34572) vs Ser44-Glu55 (Fig. 2B); D-loop subset is Leu122-Asp131 (p. 34574) vs Lys122-Asp131 (Table 2).
